items.title: CVE-2021-21551: Dell dbutil denial of service and privilege escalation in kernel driver (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A flaw in the Dell dbutil driver, which Dell update and support tools install on Windows Dell computers, lets an attacker who already has a low-privilege local account escalate privileges, crash the system, or access information they shouldn't. Attacks using this bug are happening, according to CISA's list of known exploited vulnerabilities.

items.title: CVE-2026-132165: Drupal core remote code execution via missing authentication (Update: CVSS score changed from 9.8 to 8.1)
items.summary: Update: CVSS score changed from 9.8 to 8.1. Drupal core has a missing authentication flaw that lets an attacker use the reachable install.php installer to try to reinstall the site, which can lead to site takeover or remote code execution. This vulnerability is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, meaning attacks are happening.

items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab could let an unauthenticated attacker remotely, without logging in, get past improper authentication if they know a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content, and so obtain sensitive information. The flaw is limited to the affected functionality and does not give unrestricted acce...

items.title: CVE-2026-133324: Mitel MiCollab authentication bypass in AWV conferencing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab could allow an attacker to bypass authentication and perform unauthorized actions within the application. The attacker can do this remotely, without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2026-59310: VMware remote code execution via path traversal in syslog server (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. A directory traversal flaw in the Syslog server of VMware vCenter (also affecting VMware Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation, Telco Cloud Infrastructure and Telco Cloud Platform) lets an attacker run arbitrary code on vCenter. It can be reached remotely over the network without logging in, and the bug is listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, meaning attacks are happening.

items.title: CVE-2025-41450: Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series authentication bypass in login grants privileged access (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series devices have an improper authentication flaw that lets an attacker bypass login and gain privileged access, reachable remotely without logging in, though a user must take some action such as clicking a link. This bug is listed by CISA as exploited in attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-133469: Xen Orchestra remote authentication bypass in REST API login tokens (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Xen Orchestra (including its xo-server component) has a flaw in how its REST API handles login tokens. A remote attacker without a login can authenticate as the owner of an unexpired login token. The attacker can then retrieve reusable login token IDs for that account.

items.title: CVE-2026-133323: Mitel MiCollab unauthenticated command execution in AWV component (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab could let an unauthenticated attacker run arbitrary commands on the system through a blind command injection caused by insufficient parameter sanitization. It can be reached remotely over the network, without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2026-133275: Mitel MiCollab unauthenticated file upload in AWV conferencing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. A flaw in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab lets an unauthenticated attacker upload arbitrary files to the affected system because file types are not checked properly. The attack can be launched remotely over the network without logging in.

items.title: CVE-2026-133303: Mitel MiCollab unauthenticated command execution in AWV conferencing (Update: added to CISA KEV)
items.summary: Update: added to CISA KEV. Mitel MiCollab's Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component does not sufficiently validate parameters, which lets an unauthenticated attacker remotely, without logging in, use pre-staged malicious content to inject XML. A successful attack could allow arbitrary commands to be run within the context of the system.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. GeoTools, a Java library for geospatial data, has an SQL injection flaw in its jsonArrayContains filter function when it runs against PostGIS layers. An attacker can reach it remotely without logging in and can execute arbitrary SQL expressions in the database; public exploit code is available.

items.title: CVE-2025-2611: ICT Innovations ICTBroadcast remote code execution in session cookie handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. ICTBroadcast by ICT Innovations passes session cookie data unsafely to shell processing, so an attacker can inject shell commands into a session cookie and run them on the server. The attack can be carried out remotely over the network without logging in, and public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2022-44384: rconfig remote code execution via file upload handler (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. An arbitrary file upload flaw in rconfig lets a remote attacker with a low-privilege login upload a crafted PHP file and run arbitrary code on the server. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2025-25034: SugarCRM PHP Deserialization RCE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. SugarCRM is affected by a PHP object injection flaw that lets a remote attacker run arbitrary code within the application, without logging in and without any user action. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available.

items.title: CVE-2026-20182: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Controller authentication bypass in fabric management plane (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Public exploit code, including a Metasploit module, is available, and the bug is being exploited in attacks.

items.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Guardrail Sandbox Escape RCE
items.summary: What is the Vulnerability? CVE-2026-40217 is a critical arbitrary-code-execution vulnerability in BerriAI LiteLLM, a widely used open-source LLM proxy/gateway. LiteLLM's guardrail feature includes a "test custom code" facility that runs user-supplied guardrail code in a sandbox. The sandbox can be escaped by rewriting Python bytecode, allowing an attacker to break out and execute arbitrary code in the context of the LiteLLM process (reported running as root in some deployments). The vector is a request to POST /guardrails/test_custom_code. CVSS is 8.8- the attacker needs minimal low-privilege…

items.title: CVE-2026-4981
items.summary: A flaw was found in Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security (ACS). An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit a vulnerability in the login interface's OAuth callback endpoint by crafting a malicious URL. This URL, containing unvalidated `error` and `error_uri` parameters, allows the attacker to display arbitrary error messages, leading to content spoofing. Furthermore, the attacker can redirect victims to malicious domains, effectively performing an open redirect under the guise of the trusted application's user interface.

items.title: CVE-2026-137524
items.summary: ToolJet from 3.20.84 before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the instance-level SSO sign-in path that hardcodes signup as enabled, ignoring all signup-disable controls. Any user with an account on the configured GitHub or Google identity provider can sign in via the OAuth endpoint to obtain an admin session in a newly created workspace.

items.title: CVE-2026-137499
items.summary: Budibase from 3.41.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over password-less global Builder accounts via unverified-email OIDC/SSO account linking. Attackers can assert a victim's email with email_verified=false at a trusted IdP, bypassing the isAccountLinkable allowlist to control all apps, datasources, and automations.

items.title: CVE-2026-137536
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authentication bypass in its server OAuth SSO sign-in module, which resolves Google and Git SSO logins solely by the provider-asserted email without checking email_verified or binding the SSO subject. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a trusted-issuer token carrying a victim's unverified email to the SSO callback to obtain the victim's session, including admin accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137523
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authentication bypass in instance-level Google SSO because the id_token audience is not verified when no Google OAuth client ID is configured, the shipped default. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a Google-signed id_token minted for their own OAuth client to /api/sso/sign-in/common/google without an organizationId, obtaining a session as any existing user with the matching email.

items.title: CVE-2026-123903: VMware authentication bypass in directory service (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. VMware vCenter Server, along with VMware Cloud Foundation and the Telco Cloud Platform and Infrastructure products, has a flaw in the VMware Directory Service that lets an attacker bypass authentication. It can be reached remotely over the network, without logging in or any user interaction, and could give an attacker full control over the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-12268: Authenticated PowerShell Injection leads to RCE (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. ManageEngine DDI Central versions below 6201 are vulnerable to PowerShell command injection in Windows DNS SPF/TXT record push leading to remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2023-35854: Authentication bypass in domain controller sessions (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus has an authentication bypass that lets a remote attacker, without logging in, steal the domain controller session token, spoof identities, and gain domain controller administrator privileges. The vendor says it has found no evidence of a security vulnerability.

items.title: CVE-2023-6634: ThimPress LearnPress remote code execution via get_content function (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The LearnPress WordPress LMS plugin, from thimpress, has a command injection flaw in its get_content function. Remotely and without logging in, an attacker can call any public function with a single parameter, which could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2022-25330: Trend Micro remote code execution in information server (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Trend Micro ServerProtect for Storage, for Microsoft Windows / Novell NetWare, for EMC Celerra, and for Network Appliance Filers contain integer overflow conditions that a remote attacker can reach over the network without logging in or any user action. Exploiting them could crash the process or allow remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2023-32530: Trend Micro Apex Central authenticated SQL injection in on-premise modules (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Trend Micro Apex Central (on-premise) has vulnerable modules that let an attacker who already has a login run SQL injection, which can lead to remote code execution. The attacker can reach it remotely over the network, but must first obtain valid credentials on the system.

items.title: CVE-2022-0948: Order Listener for WooCommerce unauthenticated SQL injection in REST route (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Order Listener for WooCommerce plugin, which plays sounds on new orders, is affected before version 3.2.2. An attacker can remotely, without logging in, send crafted input through a REST route to run SQL commands against the site's database.

items.title: CVE-2023-53963: Unauthenticated OS command injection in login.php (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. SOUND4 IMPACT, FIRST, PULSE, and Eco products, along with the BigVoice4, BigVoice2, and Stream products and Kantar Media's WM2, contain an unauthenticated OS command injection flaw. Remote attackers without logging in can run arbitrary shell commands with web server privileges by sending commands in the 'password' POST parameter of login.php and index.php.

items.title: CVE-2026-124002: Copeland XWEB EVO pre-auth command injection via username field (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Copeland's XWEB EVO is affected by a flaw that lets a remote attacker, without logging in, run arbitrary operating system commands by injecting shell characters into the username field before the password check. Because the attacker can combine this with a root-level interpreter on the device, they could gain full control of the system.

items.title: CVE-2026-137939
items.summary: Sparkle 2.2.0 before 2.9.6 contains a link following vulnerability in -submitInstallerAtPath: in SUInstallerLauncher.m that builds a root updater's launcher cache path inside the console user's home directory and then deletes and creates items there without rejecting symbolic links. items.title: CVE-2026-137938
items.summary: Sparkle before 2.9.6 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in the installer's SPUInstallationData handling in AppInstaller.m, which validates the symlink-resolved download URL but performs the privileged move on the unresolved URL and checks the file type only afterwards. A local user can swap an intermediate directory of the download path for a symlink between the check and the move, causing a root installer to rename a file out of a protected location and leading to privilege escalation when the installer runs in the system domain.

This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when the WebP Express "URL replacement" method is set to "Alter HTML", and full privilege escalation — such as provisioning a new administrator accoun…

items.title: CVE-2026-137540
items.summary: Tornado before 6.6.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in StaticFileHandler on Windows that allows unauthenticated attackers to read NTFS Alternate Data Streams by appending :streamname to URL paths. Attackers can request stream paths that pass the get_absolute_path and _check_in_root prefix checks to read hidden stream content, such as stored secrets or Zone.Identifier source data.

items.title: CVE-2026-137522
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in QueryAuthGuard that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute queries from unreleased app versions. Attackers can POST to the data-queries run endpoint with a draft query ID from any public app to execute unpublished queries against connected datasources.

items.title: CVE-2026-137504
items.summary: actix-multipart (actix-web) before 0.8.7 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the MultipartForm extractor that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory or file descriptors by sending unlimited parts. Attackers can stream many zero-byte parts uncounted by total_limit and memory_limit, pinning 128 KiB buffers or opening temporary files to crash workers.

items.title: CVE-2026-137500
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin Creator or app-builder users to read pending invite bearer codes via GET /api/global/users/invites. Attackers can submit a stolen code with a chosen password to the public /api/global/users/invite/accept endpoint, hijacking invited identities up to global admin.

items.title: CVE-2026-137497
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve legacy LiteLLM credentials by querying the public settings endpoint. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to /api/global/configs/public to obtain liteLLM.keyId and secretKey, enabling unauthorized use of tenant LiteLLM resources.

items.title: CVE-2026-137483
items.summary: Hono from 4.13.11 before 4.13.18 contains a middleware bypass vulnerability in serveStatic that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip prefix middleware by exploiting a second path decode when allowPercentInPath is enabled. Attackers can send malformed percent-encoded sequences so the router matches an encoded path while serveStatic serves the real file, bypassing authentication checks.

This is due to missing file type validation in the process_file_input_field function, which accepts the client-supplied multipart Content-Type header as the sole type gate and writes the uploaded file to the unprotected pif_temp directory using the verbatim client-supplied filename. items.title: CVE-2026-137480
items.summary: Traefik 3.7.15 before 3.7.18 and 3.8.0-rc.1 before 3.8.0-rc.2 contains a client certificate authentication bypass in the Kubernetes Ingress NGINX provider because, on hosts shared by multiple Ingresses using auth-tls-secret, Ssl-Client-* headers are built per Ingress while the TLS handshake uses the first Ingress's settings. Unauthenticated remote attackers can obtain Ssl-Client-Verify: SUCCESS with a client-chosen subject and issuer for an unverified certificate, or inject Ssl-Client-* headers directly, presenting forged identities to backends that trust the proxy.

items.title: CVE-2026-137478
items.summary: Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 contain an authentication bypass in the ForwardAuth middleware because connection isolation for NTLM and Negotiate credentials checks only the Authorization header, not Proxy-Authorization. Unauthenticated attackers can send such credentials in Proxy-Authorization to reuse a shared authentication-server connection already authenticated by another user, receive that user's identity via authResponseHeaders, and access backends as that user.

items.title: CVE-2026-137465
items.summary: Parse Server 3.10.0 before 8.6.123 and 9.0.0 before 9.11.1-alpha.4 contains an authentication bypass in the Google Play Games authentication adapter, which does not verify that the supplied player ID belongs to the presented access token. Attackers can sign in with their own Google Play Games credential while claiming another user's player ID to take over that account or link that player ID to their own account.

items.title: CVE-2026-93087
items.summary: A maliciously modified field in the locally stored JSON description for an update made available by Autodesk, when processed by Autodesk Access, can cause attacker-controlled HTML content to be executed in another user's session. A local, authenticated malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of another user if that user interacts with an injected link, resulting in privilege escalation.

items.title: CVE-2026-137581
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6, and jwt-encryption and jwt-signature through 3.2.10, contain a denial of service vulnerability because the JWS and JWE serializers pass attacker-controlled tokens and protected headers to json_decode() without bounds before verification. Unauthenticated attackers can submit large tokens with colliding header member names or deeply nested arrays to cause quadratic decoding time or fatal memory exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-137553
items.summary: Frappe Framework before 15.120.0 and 16.x before 16.33.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in the handling of the X-Frappe-Request-Id HTTP header when monitoring is enabled. Remote unauthenticated attackers can send crafted header values to infer database contents through blind SQL injection techniques.

items.title: CVE-2026-137513
items.summary: justhtml before 3.17.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in decode_entities_in_text that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash parsing via non-ASCII Unicode digits in numeric character references. Attackers can submit a payload like &#² in HTML text or attributes, causing an uncaught ValueError from int() that aborts JustHTML() and stream() parsing.

items.title: CVE-2026-109921
items.summary: Authentication bypass in the system.setPillar and system.getPillar functions in Uyuni before 5.1.35, 5.2.0 before 5.2.25, 5.3.0 before 5.3.5 could be used by logged in attackers to inject code into other managed system spaces.

items.title: CVE-2026-137498
items.summary: Budibase Server from 3.39.18 before 4.0.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to erase MongoDB query filters by supplying __proto__ as a dynamic JSON key in PUBLIC queries. Attackers can send a single request to the query execution endpoint, reducing the filter to {} to read, update, or delete every document in the collection.

items.title: CVE-2026-137493
items.summary: Budibase server from 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows view users and anonymous visitors to access entire base tables by passing a view id to the /api/:viewId/rows routes. Attackers can read, export, modify, and delete rows outside the view filter, including hidden columns, or read the full table unauthenticated through PUBLIC views.

items.title: CVE-2026-137486
items.summary: Hono from 4.13.16 before 4.13.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in mount() and app.mount() that forwards an incorrect path when a custom getPath adds a prefix. Unauthenticated attackers can request crafted paths that the mounted application resolves differently, reaching routes protected by path-scoped middleware such as authentication checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-137485
items.summary: Hono from 4.5.1 before 4.13.18 contains a validation bypass vulnerability in validator('json') and validator('form') that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip validation by formatting Content-Type parameters differently. Attackers can add whitespace before semicolons, trailing semicolons, or underscored parameter names so validators receive empty objects while handlers still read rejected fields.

items.title: CVE-2026-137484
items.summary: Hono from 4.12.16 before 4.13.18 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the bodyLimit() middleware that retains every transfer chunk as a separate array. Unauthenticated attackers can send a within-limit request body in one-byte chunks to create millions of retained objects, terminating Bun or Node.js processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137482
items.summary: Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 before 3.8.0-rc.2 contain a denial of service vulnerability in the BasicAuth middleware, which does not limit password length before MD5-crypt ($apr1$, $1$) hashing. Unauthenticated attackers can send passwords up to the entry point maxHeaderBytes limit (1 MiB by default), consuming excessive CPU per request and degrading availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-137481
items.summary: Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 contain an authorization bypass because the sanitizePath entry point option leaves dot-segments carrying path parameters, such as /..;x/, unresolved when matching routers and applying middlewares. Unauthenticated attackers can send requests like /public/..;x/admin to a parameter-stripping backend shared with a protected router, bypassing authentication or authorization middlewares to reach protected resources.

items.title: CVE-2026-137479
items.summary: Traefik 3.1.0 before 3.7.18 and 3.8.0-rc.1 contain a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the Compress middleware, which creates zstd encoders with library default options that retain about 18 MiB of state per response until it is fully written. Unauthenticated remote attackers can open many concurrent requests and read responses slowly to exhaust memory and crash Traefik.

items.title: CVE-2026-137476
items.summary: vLLM 0.3.0 before 0.30.0 contains a response amplification vulnerability in the OpenAI-compatible API server's shared RequestValidationError handler, which renders every Pydantic validation error, each of which can include the full offending input, in its HTTP 400 response. Unauthenticated attackers can send a malformed request to endpoints such as POST /v1/responses to trigger a disproportionately large error response that consumes server CPU and memory and can disrupt downstream clients and proxies.

items.title: CVE-2026-137457
items.summary: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.33.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the shadow server's fast-path input handlers in fastpath.c that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject input before activation. Attackers can negotiate TLS-only RDP, skip Confirm Active, and send Fast-Path Input Event PDUs to inject keystrokes and mouse movement into the host X11 session via XTEST.

items.title: CVE-2026-137584

items.title: CVE-2026-137585

items.title: CVE-2026-71411
items.summary: GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Time-of-Check/Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition in the hardcopy file handler. Due to checking write permissions using the real user ID and subsequently opening the file using the effective user ID, a local unprivileged attacker can atomically replace the target path with a symbolic link pointing to an arbitrary system file. Successfully exploiting this race condition allows the attacker to write to arbitrary files with root privileges, leading to local privilege escalation This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-137586

items.title: CVE-2026-137582
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 allows denial of service because JWELoader and JWSLoader try every recipient or signature of a JSON General serialized token without limiting their number. Unauthenticated attackers can send a small JWE with many empty recipients inheriting a maximal PBES2 p2c value, forcing repeated key derivations that exhaust worker CPU.

items.title: CVE-2026-137580

Unauthenticated remote attackers can send large tokens holding thousands of empty signatures to exhaust CPU and occupy PHP workers without any valid key or token.

items.title: CVE-2026-137559
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 allow CPU exhaustion because, on PHP without GMP, AbstractECDH falls back to pure PHP curve code that converts unbounded ECDH-ES epk x and y coordinates to big integers before any length check. Unauthenticated attackers who know only the recipient key's curve can send small JWEs with oversized epk coordinates, keeping workers busy for seconds to minutes per token.

items.title: CVE-2026-137307
items.summary: wpa_supplicant 2.7 through 2.12 with the wolfSSL backend contains an EAP-FAST server authentication bypass in tls_sess_sec_cb() that skips master secret derivation for oversized PAC-Opaque tickets. Adjacent attackers running a rogue authenticator can complete the handshake with an all-zero master secret to capture MS-CHAPv2 responses for offline cracking and replace the stored PAC.

items.title: CVE-2026-137306
items.summary: Grav Admin plugin before 1.10.65 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability in LoginController::taskForgot() that ignores the Require Trusted Host setting when building reset links. Unauthenticated attackers who know an administrator's username can submit the forgot-password form with a forged Host header, capturing the reset token when clicked to take over accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-133971
items.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in the web management interface of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave). Successful exploitation could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized administrative access to the affected system, impacting the confidentiality and integrity of AirWave.

items.title: CVE-2026-133211
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the ct0 request parameter of the delivery scripts is only required to start with http:// or https:// and is prepended unescaped to banner click URLs. An unauthenticated attacker can craft a delivery URL that executes JavaScript in the delivery origin when a visitor follows it. An active banner using the raw {clickurl} macro is required.

items.title: CVE-2026-133203
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the public conversion-variable endpoint does not verify that a caller-supplied conversion belongs to the supplied tracker. An unauthenticated attacker can submit a unique variable for a different tracker's conversion, causing that conversion to be classified as a duplicate and excluded from conversion reports.

items.title: CVE-2026-69695
items.summary: Handesk through 1.5 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in Attachment::storeAttachmentFromRequest() that allows authenticated agents to upload files with arbitrary extensions by attaching them to ticket comments without extension, MIME type, or size validation. Attackers can upload a PHP file via POST /tickets/{ticket}/comments, which is stored under storage/app/public/attachments and served from /storage/attachments/, to achieve remote code execution as the web server user or serve malicious HTML/SVG content from the application origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-69696
items.summary: Handesk through 1.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the POST /webhook/bitbucket route, which is excluded from CSRF verification and processed by WebhookController::store() without validating any secret, signature, or request source before writing to the database. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted Bitbucket issue payloads referencing a linked roadmap Idea or ticket to alter the Idea's status or inject attacker-controlled notes attributed to the first administrator account.

items.title: CVE-2026-131819
items.summary: ChargePoint Home Flex Debug Interface With Improper Access Control Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows physically present attackers to bypass authentication on affected ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the serial debug interface. The issue results from the lack of access control prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28997.

items.title: CVE-2026-131818
items.summary: ChargePoint Home Flex busybox Unnecessary Privileges Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the busybox binary. The issue results from the setuid flag being set. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-29090.

items.title: CVE-2026-131816
items.summary: ChargePoint Home Flex ssh Hard-coded Credentials Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ssh service, which listens on TCP port 22 by default. The issue results from the use of hard-coded credentials. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28996.

items.title: CVE-2026-123879
items.summary: In authd before 0.7.2, an improper access control vulnerability allows an authenticated remote attacker to complete a first-time SSH login with another account's UID and incorrect primary GID, and to read or modify files owned by that account. items.title: CVE-2026-102987
items.summary: Plane is an open-source project management tool. In versions prior to 1.4.0, the v2 asset static endpoint allows unauthenticated requests and returns presigned S3 URLs for an asset with access-signed parameters. Any user who knows an asset UUID can retrieve the signed URL without an account, providing access to that asset. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.0.

items.summary: Improper certificate validation vulnerabilities in the web-based management interface of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave) allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to circumvent existing authentication controls if certain preconditions outside of the attacker's control are met. items.summary: Teracom TCW122B-CM firmware before 4.07 contains a predictable session cookie vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack administrator sessions by guessing tick-counter-derived cookies. items.title: CVE-2026-137066
items.summary: Loginizer before 2.1.4 contains a brute-force lockout bypass vulnerability in loginizer_login_failed() that allows unauthenticated attackers to avoid failed-attempt recording via non-ASCII URL bytes. Attackers can append invalid UTF-8 or 4-byte sequences to wp-login.php or xmlrpc.php request URLs, causing the log INSERT to fail and enabling unlimited password guessing without lockout or email notification.

items.title: CVE-2026-114507
items.summary: LightRAG provides simple and fast retrieval-augmented generation. Prior to 1.5.5, query responses are cached under a key that omits conversation_history, so an unauthenticated attacker can poison the cached answers returned to other users who send the same query. This issue is fixed in version 1.5.5.

items.summary: NodeBB 4.12.0 before 4.16.4 contains an execution after redirect vulnerability in the Intents.create controller that allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger ActivityPub note ingestion. Attackers can send GET requests to /intents/create with a remote note URI in the toPid parameter to inject federated content as local topics and posts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137064
items.summary: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the Bandwidth SMS webhook endpoint POST /webhooks/sms/:phone_number that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit forged SMS events. Attackers who know an inbox phone number can set the 'to' field to inject inbound messages with forged sender numbers or forge delivery status updates.

items.title: CVE-2026-137059
items.summary: ToolJet from 3.16.0 before 3.20.256 contains an improper signature verification vulnerability in StripeWebhookGuard that validates webhooks against a self-generated signature instead of the Stripe-Signature header. Unauthenticated attackers can post forged Stripe events to the POST /api/organization/payment/webhooks route to activate subscriptions, generate licenses, change plans or seats, and add AI credits without payment.

items.title: CVE-2026-137058
items.summary: Cron-parser through 5.10.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in CronExpressionParser.parse() that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by supplying oversized cron fields. Attackers can submit a roughly 1.6 MB expression of repeated wildcard tokens that expand into huge arrays, exhausting the V8 heap and crashing the Node.js process.

items.title: CVE-2026-137057
items.summary: llama.cpp from b7118 before b12604 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in llama_grammar_parser::parse_sequence() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to cause denial of service by supplying GBNF repetitions with max lower than min. Attackers can send a grammar like {5,2} in the grammar field of a llama-server /completion request, wrapping n_opt to generate endless repetition rules that hang the process and exhaust memory.

items.title: Incident Memory: Chronology of an Extortion-as-a-Service Attack (II)
items.summary: In December 2025, the Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) at G DATA handled an extortion-as-a-service attack on a mid-sized company. During the attack, data was exfiltrated on a large scale. In the second part of this post, we go into the technical details. The analysis shows that the methods were professional and the approach was less conspicuous than that of an average ransomware group.

items.title: CVE-2019-17563: Apache Tomcat session fixation in FORM authentication (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat has a session fixation flaw in its FORM authentication. A remote attacker, without logging in, could fix a victim's session ID, but the victim must take an action and the window for the attack is narrow.

items.title: CVE-2018-1336: Apache Tomcat denial of service in the UTF-8 decoder (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat, from the Apache Software Foundation, mishandles overflow in its UTF-8 decoder when it processes supplementary characters. A remote attacker who does not need to log in can trigger an infinite loop and cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2019-0199: Apache Tomcat denial of service in HTTP/2 stream handling (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat is affected by a flaw in its HTTP/2 handling that lets a remote attacker, without logging in, open streams and keep them open while sending excessive SETTINGS frames and never reading or writing data. This ties up server threads running blocking I/O, which can exhaust them and cause a denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2016-6816: Apache Tomcat remote response injection via HTTP request line parsing (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Apache Tomcat accepts invalid characters in HTTP request lines, and when paired with a proxy that reads them differently, a remote attacker can inject data into HTTP responses without logging in, though a user action is needed. This can be used to poison a web cache, carry out cross-site scripting, or obtain sensitive information from requests other than the attacker's own, and public exploit c...

items.title: CVE-2026-87719: GitLab credential leak via deserialization in Advanced Search (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. GitLab Enterprise Edition, a self-hosted software platform for source code management and DevOps, is affected by this flaw. An authenticated user with access to Duo Chat could potentially view Advanced Search configuration details and sensitive credentials.

items.title: CVE-2026-99362: Linux kernel out-of-bounds write in NFSD SEQUENCE reply handling (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. The Linux kernel's nfsd server component has a flaw in how it handles SEQUENCE replies with a negotiated small cached reply size. A client can trigger an out-of-bounds write in kernel memory, and the client can read back part of the data written past the end of the buffer.

items.title: CVE-2026-129182: PHP memory corruption via stale last_fatal_error_backtrace (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. A use-after-free flaw in PHP (from the PHP Group) lets an attacker corrupt memory, crash PHP-FPM or mod_php workers, and possibly run their own code. It can be reached remotely without logging in, but only on servers with specific per-path or per-directory configuration, where a fatal error during request shutdown leaves stale data that a later request on the same worker then uses.

items.title: CVE-2026-129481: PHP memory corruption in session shutdown cleanup (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. PHP's session extension has a use-after-free flaw: if a fatal error occurs in an application callback during session shutdown, a stale pointer to the script filename can later be freed by another request handled by the same worker. An attacker who can trigger such a failing cleanup could crash the worker or corrupt memory, reaching it remotely without logging in, though it only applies when the...

items.title: CVE-2020-9402: SQL injection in GIS functions and aggregates on Oracle (Update: proof of concept on GitHub published)
items.summary: Update: proof of concept on GitHub published. Django contains a SQL injection flaw when untrusted data is passed as the tolerance parameter in GIS functions and aggregates on Oracle. An attacker who can log in with low privileges can reach it remotely over the network and inject malicious SQL.

items.title: CVE-2026-133204
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone-linking page can disclose campaign and banner names and identifiers belonging to another agency. An authenticated manager, or a website user with permission to link banners to zones, can supply another agency's advertiser and campaign identifiers because the selection lists are not restricted to the agency owning the zone.

items.title: CVE-2026-133202
items.summary: In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager with access to two advertisers can associate a conversion tracker owned by one advertiser with a campaign owned by the other. The tracker-campaign page checks access to each object but does not verify that their actual owners match. The resulting association can expose the first advertiser's tracker name and identifier in the second advertiser's restricted conversion report.

items.title: dynmx

In a simplified way, you can think of dynmx as a sort of YARA for API call traces so called function logs originating from malware sandboxes. Hence, the data basis for the detection approach are not the malware samples themselves which are analyzed statically but data that is generated during a dynamic analysis of the malware sample in a malware sandbox. items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table read permission to execute JavaScript by injecting Handlebars js helpers into row search query values. items.title: CVE-2026-137535
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to recover plaintext workspace secret constants through OAuth URL generation. Attackers can send POST /api/data-sources/fetch-oauth2-base-url with {{secrets.*}} in source_options and arbitrary organization_id and environment_id to receive secrets, including other workspaces' secrets, in the returned authorization URL.

items.title: CVE-2026-137528
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated same-organization users to invoke OAuth2 authorization on data sources they cannot configure. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/data-sources/:id/authorize_oauth2 to bind attacker-controlled OAuth credentials or overwrite token state for foreign data sources.

items.title: CVE-2026-137552

An attacker with a user's valid credentials can use this grant to obtain a full-access OAuth token, bypassing 2FA.

items.title: CVE-2026-135899
items.summary: JobRouter Premium, version 2025.1.11, has a stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Favorites feature. An authenticated user with low privileges can inject JavaScript code that is persistently stored on the server. When other users access the affected page, the code executes in their browsers. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to perform unauthorized actions on behalf of the victim, access sensitive information, or compromise the integrity of their sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-137435
items.summary: A flaw was found in the SAML identity brokering component of Keycloak. When Keycloak is configured to use a database with case-insensitive collation, it may incorrectly match a SAML subject name to an existing user account if the names differ only by case. This issue allows an attacker to log in as a different user by providing a case-distinct version of a victim's username in a signed SAML assertion, leading to unauthorized account access.

items.title: USN-9206-1: Guava vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that Guava did not correctly handle permissions for certain temporary directories. An attacker could possibly use this issue to read or modify sensitive information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS. (CVE-2020-8908, CVE-2023-2976) Kaya Emre Arikan discovered that Guava did not correctly handle deserializing certain data. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. (CVE-2026-102554)

items.title: CVE-2026-136513
items.summary: When Debug or CommLog is enabled and the log directory cannot be used, psqlODBC falls back to a directory under the user's home directory. It wrote that path with an unexpanded ~, which is resolved relative to the process's current directory. Another local user who controls a directory on that path can make the driver create the victim's mylog_*.log and psqlodbc_*.log files in any directory the victim can write to, or leave the victim's process blocked in open(). items.title: CVE-2026-123912: VMware out-of-bounds write in XHCI USB controller
items.summary: VMware ESXi, Workstation and Fusion (along with VMware Cloud Foundation and Telco Cloud Platform) have an out-of-bounds write flaw in the XHCI USB controller. An attacker with local access, and no login or user interaction needed, can exploit it to gain high-level control over confidentiality, integrity and availability, potentially affecting systems beyond the vulnerable component.

items.title: CVE-2026-123910: VMware ESX remote system takeover in I/O filter service
items.summary: A heap out-of-bounds write flaw in the I/O filter service of VMware ESX, which is also included in VMware Cloud Foundation and VMware Telco Cloud Platform, can be exploited remotely without logging in and with no user interaction. The flaw is rated critical and could let an attacker take control of the affected system, compromising its confidentiality, integrity and availability.

items.title: CVE-2026-123911: VMware ESX system takeover in I/O filter service
items.summary: A use-after-free flaw in the I/O filter service of VMware ESX, which also affects VMware Cloud Foundation and VMware Telco Cloud Platform, could let an attacker take control of the affected system, with high impact on confidentiality, integrity and availability. It can be reached remotely over the network, without logging in and without any user interaction.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the login functionality of Disk Pulse Enterprise version 9.0.34. An attacker can send a specially crafted HTTP POST request to the /login endpoint with an overly long username parameter, causing a buffer overflow in the libspp.dll component. Successful exploitation allows arbitrary code execution with SYSTEM privileges.

items.summary: Update: now rated critical. A command injection flaw in the Wavlink AC3000's wireless.cgi component lets an attacker run arbitrary commands on the device by sending a specially crafted HTTP request. The attacker must reach the device over the network and log in with high-level privileges first.

items.title: CVE-2023-5824: Red Hat denial of service in Squid web proxy (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Squid, the web proxy shipped in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and several of its update streams, can be made to stall or crash its worker process. An attacker can cause this denial of service remotely, without logging in, when a large cached HTTP response header is read back from disk.

items.title: CVE-2026-1324: Operation and Maintenance Management System command injection in SSH session handling (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Sangfor Operation and Maintenance Management System contains an OS command injection flaw in its SSH protocol session handling, where manipulating the keypassword argument lets an attacker run operating system commands. The attack can be launched remotely over the network by someone with low-privilege login access.

items.title: CVE-2022-26019: pfSense CE and pfSense Plus arbitrary command execution via NTP GPS settings (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Improper access control in pfSense CE and pfSense Plus lets a remote attacker who already holds the privilege to change NTP GPS settings rewrite existing files on the system, which may lead to arbitrary command execution. The attacker reaches it over the network after logging in with low-level access and needs no action from a user.

items.title: CVE-2022-26151: Command injection in mobile management server (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Citrix XenMobile Server has a command injection flaw that lets an attacker insert and run commands on the affected system. An attacker can reach it remotely over the network, but only after logging in with high-level privileges.

items.title: CVE-2023-46846: Squid: request/response smuggling in http/1.1 and icap (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. Squid, as shipped in several Red Hat Enterprise Linux products, mishandles chunked encoding in HTTP/1.1 and ICAP traffic. A remote attacker can send smuggled requests and responses over the network, without logging in or any user action, to bypass firewall and frontend security systems.

items.title: CVE-2025-34024: Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini OS Command Injection via mp.asp (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini firmware has an OS command injection flaw in its mp.asp form handler. A network attacker who has logged in with low privileges can inject shell metacharacters into the command parameter and run arbitrary commands as root.

items.title: CVE-2025-34029: Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini OS Command Injection via syscmd.asp (Update: now rated critical)
items.summary: Update: now rated critical. The Edimax EW-7438RPn Mini firmware has an OS command injection flaw in its syscmd.asp form handler. A remote attacker with a low-privilege login can run arbitrary shell commands as the root user.

items.title: CVE-2026-104286: Fortinet FortiMail path traversal enables file writes in HTTP request handling (Update: Nuclei template published)
items.summary: Update: Nuclei template published. A path traversal flaw in Fortinet FortiMail lets an attacker write arbitrary files on the underlying system, which Fortinet rates as able to lead to unauthorized code or command execution. It can be reached remotely, without logging in, by sending crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests, and it is being exploited in attacks.

An authenticated attacker could therefore cause the Flowintel server to issue requests to arbitrary int…

items.title: CVE-2026-137911
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in xwd_encode_frame() in libavcodec/xwdenc.c that copies each RGB24 or BGR24 row using the padded XWD scanline size instead of the pixel row size. Attackers who control the width of video encoded to XWD by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

items.title: CVE-2026-137910
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in pcx_encode_frame() in libavcodec/pcxenc.c that rounds each row up to an even number of bytes and run-length encodes that many bytes from the input frame. Attackers who control the width of images encoded to PCX by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the end of the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

items.title: CVE-2026-137909
items.summary: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xsub_encode() in libavcodec/xsubenc.c that only warns when a subtitle has no rectangles and then dereferences rects[0]. Attackers can supply crafted PGS or DVB subtitles that decode to empty subtitle events, crashing applications that pass decoded subtitles directly to the XSUB encoder.

items.title: CVE-2026-137908
items.summary: FFmpeg 7.1 before 9.1 contains a memory leak vulnerability in eb_receive_packet() in libavcodec/libsvtav1.c that returns without unreferencing the queued input frame when eb_send_frame() fails. Attackers can supply crafted video in which some frames lack Dolby Vision metadata to an SVT-AV1 encode with Dolby Vision RPU coding enabled, leaking each rejected frame's buffers or aborting in av_frame_move_ref() in builds with assertions enabled.

items.title: CVE-2026-137905

Attackers can supply a crafted IMF ASSETMAP.xml whose Chunk lacks a Path, passing a NULL URI to the path handling functions and crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-133845
items.summary: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-portal. When a sandboxed application invokes Spawn() and maps two different file descriptors to the same handle, dup2() can fail. Affected Flatpak versions do not handle that failure, so a file descriptor that was open inside flatpak-portal (commonly the unfiltered D-Bus session bus) can be passed into the subsandbox. A malicious or compromised Flatpak app with no special privileges can use this to escape the sandbox.

items.title: CVE-2026-133842
items.summary: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-system-helper. When a system-wide app, runtime, or extension uses the extra-data mechanism and its apply_extra logic creates a deeply nested directory tree, permission canonicalization can fail (for example with EMFILE). Affected Flatpak versions can still report success without clearing setuid/setgid bits, leaving a setuid-root executable under /var/lib/flatpak. A local attacker who can install or update such content system-wide, or who can already execute code as a local user in cooperation with that content, can escalate privileges to root.

items.title: CVE-2026-132890
items.summary: In Eclipse Dataspace Components (EDC) Connector 1.0.0-RC2 through 1.0.0-RC7, the HashiCorp Vault extension does not reject .. path segments in secret aliases. In a multi-participant (virtual) control plane where vault partitions share the runtime's Vault token, an authenticated participant can set a callback secret alias that escapes its own vault partition. The connector then reads secrets of other participants or of the runtime, such as STS client secrets or the encryption key, and sends them to an endpoint the attacker chooses.

items.title: CVE-2026-115841
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. DSA signature verification does not reject a public key with generator 1 and public value 1 before calling the cryptographic backend. Upstream reports that the Nettle and OpenSSL backends, including the default Nettle build, accept this key. Under that key, a signature can verify for every message. Ordinary DSA keys are not affected. An application is exposed when that degenerate certificate is accepted as authoritative.

items.title: CVE-2026-115836
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The default ASCII-armor parser accepts Unicode dash characters in armor framing and ignores leading quote characters. A crafted byte stream can be parsed as one message by this tolerant parser and as a different message by a strict ASCII-armor parser. The strict mode is opt-in; the default parser remains tolerant.

items.title: CVE-2026-115835
items.summary: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The ASCII-armor reader does not limit the length of a line. Parsing an armored message with a very long line can exhaust memory in the process. Memory use follows the input size, with a small constant factor, and is not a classic amplification.

An application that prints those values can misrender the identity or alter terminal output. Signature verification of ordinary keys is not changed. Fixed in sequoia-openpgp 2.5.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-95622
items.summary: A flaw was found in ModemManager. When parsing a Cell Broadcast Message, some 3GPP data-coding-scheme values (8-bit and reserved character sets) are not handled. items.title: CVE-2026-137506
items.summary: ezdxf through 1.4.5 contains a code injection vulnerability in the dxf2code add-on that allows attackers to inject Python code via unescaped single quotes in DXF table entry names. Attackers can craft a DXF file whose layer, linetype, style, or appid names break out of quoted strings in generated scripts, executing code with the privileges of the user running them.

items.title: CVE-2026-137436
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Basic Hotel Online Reservation System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file add_reserve.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument room_id results in sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-137668
items.summary: A flaw has been found in ONNX ONNXMLTools up to 1.16.0. This impacts the function visualize_model of the file onnxmltools/utils/visualize.py. This manipulation of the argument producer_name causes basic cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

items.title: CVE-2026-137450
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in GH05TCREW PentestAgent 0.2.0. This vulnerability affects the function _execute_single of the file pentestagent/agents/base_agent.py of the component Workspace Scope Gate. Such manipulation leads to missing authorization. The attack needs to be performed locally. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-136977
items.summary: Improper authentication in the guest API connection handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a root user inside an unisolated instance to impersonate another instance and read its configuration, metadata, and devices across project boundaries via holding open connections across PID wrap-around.

items.title: CVE-2026-136976
items.summary: Improper link resolution before file access in recursive file pull in Canonical LXD before 4.0.15, 5.0.11, 5.21.9, and 6.8 on case-insensitive client filesystems allows an authenticated user with write access to an instance directory or custom volume to write arbitrary files outside the target directory and execute code as the operator via case-variant symlinks.

items.title: CVE-2026-136974
items.summary: Configuration injection in liblxc instance configuration generation in Canonical LXD before 6.10.2, 5.21.10, 5.0.12, 4.0.16 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access or a local user of the LXD user socket to execute arbitrary commands as root on the host via line breaks in instance configuration keys and values.

items.title: CVE-2026-135385
items.summary: Incorrect authorization in backup export and network zone read endpoints in Canonical LXD before 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with view-only access to export instance and custom storage volume backups and read network zone TSIG peer keys via endpoints enforcing only view permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-135383
items.summary: Incorrect authorization in TLS certificate trust store and revocation handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated client with a restricted or revoked TLS certificate to gain unrestricted administrative access to the server or cluster via trust-lookup races, forwarded cluster identity headers, CA-issued certificate detaching, or stale revocation and session state.

items.title: CVE-2026-135382
items.summary: Path traversal in backup, image, storage volume, and migration handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access to read and write arbitrary host files as root and exhaust daemon memory via crafted symlinks, unvalidated path components, or oversized metadata.

items.title: CVE-2026-135377
items.summary: Exposure of sensitive information in API responses, exports, and host-side artifacts in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated lower-privileged user or a local host user to read credentials, private keys, and other projects' metadata and inject arguments into Ceph administration commands via unfiltered endpoints, exported configurations, log files, process command lines, and unvalidated bucket parameters.

items.title: CVE-2026-135374
items.summary: Insufficient verification of data authenticity in shared image handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user restricted to a single project to export private images, replace public image contents, remove other projects' images, and pin daemon memory via abusing fingerprint-based image sharing, partial fingerprints, and non-expiring push upload tokens.

items.title: CVE-2026-135373
items.summary: Path traversal in container device path resolution and VM disk format detection in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project access, including an unprivileged local user through lxd-user, to read and modify arbitrary host files or Ceph RBD images and gain root privileges on the host via crafted device paths or QCOW2 backing file references.

items.title: CVE-2026-127163
items.summary: Improper certificate validation in websocket connections in Canonical pylxd before 2.4.3 allows a network attacker to read command stdin and spoof command output via impersonating a remote LXD endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-127162
items.summary: Improper output encoding in Prometheus metrics exposition in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a user controlling a virtual machine to forge host metric labels and break metrics scraping via unescaped guest-controlled filesystem mountpoints and network interface names.

items.title: CVE-2026-127161
items.summary: Exposure of sensitive information in live and stateful migration operations in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project event or operation read access to read a migrating instance's checkpointed runtime state and disrupt the migration via capturing the state connection secret from operation events or queries.

items.title: CVE-2026-127160
items.summary: Configuration injection in virtual machine disk device handling in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with VM creation permissions in a restricted project to bypass low-level VM restrictions and control the root QEMU process via quotes and line breaks in a disk device's guest path.

items.title: CVE-2026-127158
items.summary: Exposure of sensitive information and missing requestor validation in instance, volume, and snapshot migration operations in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project event or operation read access to read migrating configuration and filesystem data and disrupt the migration via capturing per-connection websocket secrets from operation metadata and racing the migration's data channels.

items.title: CVE-2026-127157
items.summary: Exposure of sensitive information in token operation events in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user restricted to a project to gain full server access and cancel pending token operations via capturing certificate or cluster join token secrets broadcast to default project event listeners.

items.title: CVE-2026-127154
items.summary: Improper link resolution in image metadata tarball unpacking in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, and 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with a restricted client certificate to write arbitrary host files as root and execute code on the host via a crafted rootfs symlink in an image metadata tarball.

items.title: CVE-2026-127153
items.summary: Path traversal in proxy and CDI GPU device name handling in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, and 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with access to a restricted project permitting proxy or GPU devices to read, overwrite, or delete arbitrary host files as root and terminate host processes via crafted device names containing path traversal sequences.

items.title: CVE-2026-127152
items.summary: Improper privilege management during container rebuild in Canonical LXD before 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a local user with container permissions to gain root privileges on the host via rebuilding a never-started unprivileged container so it starts without a user namespace or privileged-container hardening.

items.title: CVE-2026-114454
items.summary: Path traversal in TPM device management in Canonical LXD from 4.8 before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a remote authenticated user with project access to recursively delete arbitrary files and directories on the host as root via a crafted device name during instance or device removal.

items.title: CVE-2026-122225
items.summary: Symbolic link following in imported VM backup config drive preparation in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project-scoped permissions to disclose sensitive host files, including LXD server and cluster keys, and overwrite host files as root via importing and starting a VM backup with a symlinked config directory.

items.title: CVE-2026-137441
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file /admin/manage_event.php. The manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-137414
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file view_event.php. Such manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-137653
items.summary: A flaw was found in spice-server. A malicious SPICE client can send a message header declaring an arbitrarily large message body. The server sizes the receive-buffer allocation from this declared size before any message content is received; when the allocation fails, the process hosting the SPICE server terminates abruptly, causing a denial of service for the virtual machine it serves. On hosts with sufficient free memory, the same technique can instead hold large amounts of memory per connection. Exploitation requires network access to the SPICE port; credential requirements depend on the ser…

items.title: CVE-2026-137596
items.summary: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw was found in KubeVirt's decentralized live migration. The connectURL field of a VirtualMachineInstanceMigration object is not validated at admission, and the privileged synchronization-controller dials the attacker-specified URL. Connection and DNS errors from the dial are exposed in a condition readable in the tenant's namespace. A user with the kubevirt.io:migrate role (a role designed for tenant delegation) can use this behavior as a blind network-reconnaissance oracle to determine the existence and connectivity of internal hosts and ports from the…

items.title: CVE-2026-7181
items.summary: This CVE ID has been rejected or withdrawn by its CVE Numbering Authority.

items.title: CVE-2026-137418
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Cerebras ModelZoo up to d76e028d6a5f784954b1329b3ae44721ca8da36a. Affected is the function StreamingShardedHFReader of the file src/cerebras/modelzoo/tools/checkpoint_converters/streaming_checkpoints.py of the component Checkpoint Converter. The manipulation of the argument weight_map leads to path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-135038
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in weDevs WP ERP erp allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP ERP: from n/a through 2.0.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-134714
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Webful Creations RepairBuddy computer-repair-shop allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects RepairBuddy: from n/a through 4.1237.

items.title: CVE-2026-134488
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Mamunur Rashid Radius Booking — Booking Calendar for Appointments & Services radius-booking allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Radius Booking — Booking Calendar for Appointments & Services: from n/a through 1.0.22.

items.title: CVE-2026-137560
items.summary: Web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 contain a denial of service vulnerability in RSAKey, which accepts RSA keys with a modulus and public exponent of unbounded length. Remote attackers can supply a crafted key, such as in the jwk header of a DPoP proof, to force seconds of CPU per PS256/PS384/PS512 verification or RSA encryption, or per any RSA operation when GMP is unavailable.

items.title: CVE-2026-137549
items.summary: pypdf before 7.0.1 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in image loading because data size estimates for some image modes are too low, defeating limits for filters without their own size limit. Attackers can craft a PDF whose images, when loaded, cause large memory usage and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137541
items.summary: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the QuickDraft Livewire component that allows any authenticated user to create posts without the post.create permission. Attackers such as self-registered Subscriber accounts can submit the dashboard Quick Draft widget to inject draft posts, bypassing the PostPolicy check enforced by PostController.

items.title: CVE-2026-137537
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated End Users to execute data queries of apps in other organizations via POST /api/data-queries/:id/run. Attackers can supply a target data-query id and runtime resolvedOptions to run queries with the datasource's decrypted credentials, reading cross-tenant query results.

items.title: CVE-2026-137532
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read cross-workspace files by requesting a known File UUID. Attackers can request GET /api/files/:id with another workspace's File UUID to retrieve stored file bytes, such as avatars, without parent resource authorization checks.

items.title: CVE-2026-137531
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows view-only workspace users to execute queries in restricted environments by supplying an arbitrary environmentId. Attackers can call the data-queries run endpoint for draft app versions to execute queries with stored datasource credentials, exposing development or staging data.

items.title: CVE-2026-137521
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated builders to read, modify, or delete other organizations' app-builder components, pages, and events. Attackers can target their own app/version in the URL to pass ValidAppGuard, then supply victim resource ids that services query without appVersionId or organizationId scoping.

items.title: CVE-2026-137519
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows Builders with only data source Delete permission to update global data sources via the PUT /api/data-sources endpoint. Attackers can change a REST data source base URL so later query executions send stored Bearer credentials to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

items.title: CVE-2026-137517
items.summary: ToolJet from 3.8.0 before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated builders to modify queries in view-only apps by supplying cross-app query IDs. Attackers can send PATCH requests to /api/data-queries/versions/:versionId naming an editable app version with another app's query ID, then run the overwritten query using that app's data source connection.

items.title: CVE-2026-137512
items.summary: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass LoopLimit by supplying large JSON input to object.from_json. Attackers can pass a flat JSON array or object with hundreds of thousands of elements, which JsonElementExtensions materializes without loop checks, exhausting CPU and memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-137509
items.summary: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows template authors to bypass LimitToString by rendering a ScriptObject with many members. Attackers can supply a small template whose ScriptObject.ToString concatenates large member values without length tracking, allocating multi-gigabyte strings and causing memory exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-137495
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the bulkDestroy function that allows authenticated users to delete rows from any workspace table by supplying foreign row IDs. Attackers with TABLE WRITE on one table can send row _id values from other tables to the DELETE /api/:sourceId/rows endpoint, causing data loss and workspace metadata deletion.

items.title: CVE-2026-137491
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a query injection vulnerability that allows low-privilege or anonymous users to inject AQL or SQL by supplying unescaped parameters to ArangoDB and Snowflake queries. Attackers can execute published queries with crafted parameter values to bypass filters, read entire datasources, and modify or delete all stored documents.

items.title: CVE-2026-137468
items.summary: SiYuan from 3.8.0 before 3.8.11 contains a lockout bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to brute-force publish passwords by forging client-computable publish-auth- cookies. Attackers can compute SHA-256(ID + candidate) locally and send it on content requests like /api/filetree/getDoc to guess passwords without throttling and read protected documents.

items.title: CVE-2026-137463
items.summary: HKUDS nanobot from 0.1.4 before 0.4.1 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the OpenAI Codex provider that retries authenticated requests without TLS certificate or hostname verification. Attackers able to intercept the connection can trigger a certificate failure and impersonate the endpoint to steal bearer tokens, read request contents, or alter responses.

items.title: CVE-2026-137406
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in SourceCodester Syllabus-Aligned Learning Management & Examination System 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file approve_enrollment.php. This manipulation causes open redirect. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-137412
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in projectworlds Online Jewellery Shopping System 1.0. The affected element is the function Dashbord_model.searchAdvance of the file /jewllary-shop/application/models/dashbord_model.php of the component Advanced Search. This manipulation of the argument from/to causes sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

items.title: CVE-2026-137620
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in RT-Thread up to 5.3.0. Affected is the function davinci_spi_get_prescale of the file bsp/dm365/drivers/spi-davinci.c of the component DM365 SPI Driver. The manipulation of the argument max_hz results in divide by zero. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The patch is identified as e12183f7b87eddf182b95bf8b400acd626880306. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-137410
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in liuwy-project zhglxt up to 3fd4ad44458f87bdad0afa997ba29706488fa1ff. This issue affects the function markdownUploadFile of the file zhglxt-web/src/main/java/com/zhglxt/web/controller/common/CommonController.java. The manipulation of the argument editormd-image-file leads to unrestricted upload. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. This product is using a rolling release to provide continious delivery. Therefore, no version details for affected nor updated releases are available.

items.title: CVE-2026-137411
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in projectworlds Online Jewellery Shopping System 1.0. Impacted is the function searchItem of the file application/models/dashbord_model.php of the component Dashbord Search. The manipulation of the argument q results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.
